# Command line

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py -- do not edit. Run `make generate` after changing its source. -->

Every command answers `--help`. A refusal a person can act on -- a setting, a scope, a token, the daemon -- is one line on stderr and exit status 1. `rocketwright --version` prints the version.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `rocketwright serve` | Run the Rocketwright daemon on 127.0.0.1 |
| `rocketwright mcp` | Serve the agent tools over stdio, for an MCP client |
| `rocketwright login` | Sign the project's app in with a login from your password manager, asked from this terminal |
| `rocketwright open` | Open this project's simulator viewer in the browser |
| `rocketwright stop` | Stop a project's device session, and the daemon when asked |
| `rocketwright doctor` | Check this Mac for what Rocketwright needs |
| `rocketwright config` | Show or change Rocketwright's settings |
| `rocketwright config path` | Print where config.toml is |
| `rocketwright config validate` | Check config.toml and the ROCKETWRIGHT_ environment |
| `rocketwright config scope` | Print the scope id Rocketwright gives a folder |
| `rocketwright config list` | Every setting and its value |
| `rocketwright config get` | One setting's value |
| `rocketwright config set` | Set a setting in config.toml |
| `rocketwright config unset` | Remove a setting from config.toml |
| `rocketwright config copy` | Copy one scope's own settings into another scope's table |
| `rocketwright settings` | Confirm a settings change a page asked for |
| `rocketwright settings confirm` | Show each sensitive change waiting, and the code that confirms it |
| `rocketwright devices` | List this Mac's simulators, real devices and Android devices, or choose one |
| `rocketwright devices list` | List the devices a project could use (the default) |
| `rocketwright devices choose` | Use this device for a project from now on |
| `rocketwright devices prune` | Delete the simulators Rocketwright made that nothing runs and that hold no app |
| `rocketwright device` | Change how a project's device looks, or where it believes it is |
| `rocketwright device appearance` | Light or dark |
| `rocketwright device status-bar` | A demo status bar, or the device's own |
| `rocketwright device location` | Where the device believes it is |
| `rocketwright device clear-location` | The device's own location again |
| `rocketwright device text-size` | Its text size |
| `rocketwright device contrast` | Increased contrast |
| `rocketwright device reduce-motion` | Reduce motion, on a real device |
| `rocketwright record` | Record a project's device as an MP4 or a GIF |
| `rocketwright record start` | Start recording the device |
| `rocketwright record stop` | Stop recording and keep it |
| `rocketwright record list` | Name the recordings kept (the default) |
| `rocketwright token` | Make, list or revoke the daemon's scoped tokens |
| `rocketwright token create` | Make a token; it is printed only this once |
| `rocketwright token list` | List the scoped tokens |
| `rocketwright token revoke` | Stop accepting a token |
| `rocketwright token sign-out` | End every viewer page's session; each needs `rocketwright open` again |
| `rocketwright tools` | List the agent tools this install offers |
| `rocketwright xcode` | Let Rocketwright use Xcode 27's tools |
| `rocketwright xcode approve` | Open a project through Xcode's tools, which is when Xcode approves Rocketwright |
| `rocketwright helper` | Build the native helper, or say which one is used |
| `rocketwright helper status` | Say which native helper is used, and whether it can be |
| `rocketwright helper build` | Build the native helper with Xcode for this version of Rocketwright |
| `rocketwright helper sign` | Sign the helper with a lasting identity, so Screen Recording and Accessibility granted to it are kept across upgrades: one you name, else this Mac's own certificate, made once (macOS asks for your password) |
| `rocketwright helper allow` | Show where System Settings allows the helper (Accessibility, Screen Recording) and show the helper in the Finder, to drag it in; needed only to drive macOS apps |
| `rocketwright app` | See what an app shares through Rocketwright's debug SDK |
| `rocketwright app hierarchy` | Print the view hierarchy the app in front shares |
| `rocketwright wda` | Set up WebDriverAgent to touch, type on and read a real device |
| `rocketwright wda status` | Say what is set up for WebDriverAgent, and whether it touches the running device now |
| `rocketwright wda teams` | List the development teams this Mac can sign WebDriverAgent with |
| `rocketwright wda setup` | Fetch WebDriverAgent and build it with your team |
| `rocketwright wda uninstall` | Remove WebDriverAgent from a device |
| `rocketwright android` | Set up and inspect Android emulators and phones |
| `rocketwright android status` | Say what is set up for Android devices (the default) |
| `rocketwright android avds` | List the Android virtual devices made with the SDK |
| `rocketwright android setup` | Fetch scrcpy's server, to see an Android device live and touch it fast |
| `rocketwright android clean` | Remove what Rocketwright left on the Android devices adb lists |
| `rocketwright version` | Print the package, protocol and connector versions |

## `rocketwright serve`

Run the Rocketwright daemon on 127.0.0.1.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--port PORT` | the port to listen on, instead of server.port |
| `--config CONFIG` | the config.toml to read, instead of the usual one |
| `--detach` | start it in the background and return |
| `--foreground` | run it in this process (the default) |

## `rocketwright mcp`

Serve the agent tools over stdio, for an MCP client.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to drive, instead of this folder's project |
| `--root ROOT` | a folder builds and installs may reach; repeatable (default: here) |
| `--label LABEL` | name this session for viewers and other agents, such as a ticket (default: ROCKETWRIGHT_AGENT_LABEL) |
| `--scope-from-roots` | act for the project of the folder each call comes from, as the client names it: for a client that serves several sessions with one server |
| `--roots-meta KEY` | the _meta key a tool call names its session's folders by, read instead of asking the client |

## `rocketwright login`

Sign the project's app in with a login from your password manager, asked from this terminal.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `APP` | the website or the app's bundle id the login is saved for |
| `--account ACCOUNT` | the username or e-mail of the account; only a login for it is used |
| `--item ITEM` | the id or title of the saved login, when several match |
| `--source SOURCE` | where logins come from, as login.sources names them: 1password, bitwarden or command:/path; repeatable (default: login.sources) |
| `--field FIELD` | the ref of the password field, from sim_snapshot (default: the only one) |
| `--code` | type the login's one-time code instead of its password |
| `--submit` | press return once it is typed |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `rocketwright open`

Open this project's simulator viewer in the browser.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to show, instead of this folder's project |
| `--print` | print the URL instead of opening it |
| `--settings` | let this page change the project's settings |
| `--device UDID` | show this device in the tab, instead of following the project's own |

## `rocketwright stop`

Stop a project's device session, and the daemon when asked.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |
| `--device UDID` | let this device go for every scope using it, instead of only this project's (it keeps running) |
| `--shutdown` | shut its simulator or emulator down too (never a real device) |
| `--daemon` | stop the Rocketwright daemon too, unless it serves others |
| `--force` | with --shutdown or --daemon: go ahead even while other scopes use it |

## `rocketwright doctor`

Check this Mac for what Rocketwright needs.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print the report as JSON |
| `--no-tap` | skip the real test tap on a simulator |
| `--device DEVICE` | the simulator (UDID) to tap, instead of a booted one |

## `rocketwright config`

Show or change Rocketwright's settings.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright config path`

Print where config.toml is.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright config validate`

Check config.toml and the ROCKETWRIGHT_ environment.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright config scope`

Print the scope id Rocketwright gives a folder.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--folder FOLDER` | this folder instead of the current one |

## `rocketwright config list`

Every setting and its value.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | as this scope sees it |

## `rocketwright config get`

One setting's value.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | a setting, such as stream.fps |
| `--scope SCOPE` | as this scope sees it |

## `rocketwright config set`

Set a setting in config.toml.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |  |
| `VALUE` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | in this scope's own table |

## `rocketwright config unset`

Remove a setting from config.toml.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | from this scope's own table |

## `rocketwright config copy`

Copy one scope's own settings into another scope's table.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--from SCOPE` | the scope to copy from |
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to copy into; what it sets already is kept |

## `rocketwright settings`

Confirm a settings change a page asked for.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright settings confirm`

Show each sensitive change waiting, and the code that confirms it.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright record`

Record a project's device as an MP4 or a GIF.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `rocketwright record start`

Start recording the device.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--format FORMAT` | what to keep, instead of recording.format (one of: mp4, gif, both) |
| `--width PIXELS` | how wide the files are, 240 to 1200, instead of the settings |
| `--quality QUALITY` | the MP4's bitrate, instead of recording.mp4_quality (one of: low, medium, high) |
| `--fps FPS` | frames a second in the MP4, instead of recording.fps (one of: 30, 60, 120) |
| `--preset PRESET` | settings made for one place: pr is an MP4 a pull request plays (one of: pr) |
| `--also ALSO` | also keep a copy as this preset, beside the recording (one of: pr) |
| `--max-seconds SECONDS` | stop by itself after this long, 5 to 3600, instead of recording.max_seconds |
| `--label TEXT` | joined into the file name: letters and digits, the rest dashes |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `rocketwright record stop`

Stop recording and keep it.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `rocketwright record list`

Name the recordings kept (the default).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `rocketwright token`

Make, list or revoke the daemon's scoped tokens.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright token create`

Make a token; it is printed only this once.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--kind KIND` |  (one of: agent, viewer, admin, host) |
| `--scope SCOPE` | a scope id, a namespace such as notes:*, or * for all; repeatable |
| `--label LABEL` | what the token is for |
| `--root ROOT` | a folder an agent or host token may reach; repeatable |

## `rocketwright token list`

List the scoped tokens.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright token revoke`

Stop accepting a token.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ID` |  |

## `rocketwright token sign-out`

End every viewer page's session; each needs `rocketwright open` again.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright tools`

List the agent tools this install offers.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print the manifest an MCP client receives |

## `rocketwright xcode`

Let Rocketwright use Xcode 27's tools.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright xcode approve`

Open a project through Xcode's tools, which is when Xcode approves Rocketwright.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | the .xcodeproj or .xcworkspace to open; default: this folder's |
| `--scope SCOPE` | use this scope's Xcode, instead of this folder's project's |

## `rocketwright helper`

Build the native helper, or say which one is used.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright helper status`

Say which native helper is used, and whether it can be.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print it as JSON |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope's settings, instead of this folder's project's |

## `rocketwright helper build`

Build the native helper with Xcode for this version of Rocketwright.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--force` | build it even when a usable one is already built |
| `--scope SCOPE` | build with this scope's Xcode, instead of this folder's project's |

## `rocketwright helper sign`

Sign the helper with a lasting identity, so Screen Recording and Accessibility granted to it are kept across upgrades: one you name, else this Mac's own certificate, made once (macOS asks for your password).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--identity IDENTITY` | a code-signing identity of yours, such as "Developer ID Application: …", kept for every later install; an empty one goes back to this Mac's own certificate |

## `rocketwright helper allow`

Show where System Settings allows the helper (Accessibility, Screen Recording) and show the helper in the Finder, to drag it in; needed only to drive macOS apps.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright app`

See what an app shares through Rocketwright's debug SDK.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright app hierarchy`

Print the view hierarchy the app in front shares.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--device DEVICE` | the simulator (UDID) to read, instead of the one booted |
| `--scope SCOPE` | use this scope's connectors.app settings, instead of this folder's |
| `--json` | print it as JSON |

## `rocketwright wda`

Set up WebDriverAgent to touch, type on and read a real device.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright wda status`

Say what is set up for WebDriverAgent, and whether it touches the running device now.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print it as JSON |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope's settings, instead of this folder's project's |

## `rocketwright wda teams`

List the development teams this Mac can sign WebDriverAgent with.

It takes no arguments.

## `rocketwright wda setup`

Fetch WebDriverAgent and build it with your team.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | with this scope's settings, instead of this folder's project's |
| `--device DEVICE` | the UDID of a cabled device to build it for, which Xcode registers with your team |

## `rocketwright wda uninstall`

|---|---|
| `UDID` | the device's UDID, as `rocketwright devices list` shows it |
| `--scope SCOPE` | with this scope's settings, instead of this folder's project's |
